items.title: QuadroDesign sends Salone booth to Zambia to become public bathroom
items.summary: The Salone del Mobile fair stand of Italian tapware brand QuadroDesign is on its way to Masala, Zambia, having been designed by Giacomo Moor to have a second life as a public bathroom. The stand will be transformed into a permanent piece of architecture, providing what QuadroDesign says will be the area's first public bathroom.
